title: 橋梁床版用フィンガー伸縮継手
description: 橋梁道路の継ぎ目に埋め込む静的なフィンガー型伸縮継手。互い違いの厚鋼板には実際の隙間があり、下面の支持アングル、補剛板、締結ボルト、埋込みアンカーと開いたゴム製受け樋を備えます。排水格子やケーブル保護スロープではありません。床版・舗装・車両は付属せず、設置時は上面を道路面に合わせて下部を沈めてください。移動・排水の機能、荷重や道路規格の適合性は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.400 × 0.371 × 1.288 m、22,460三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static embedded finger expansion joint for bridge-road deck seams. Interleaved thick steel comb plates have actual clearance gaps, with underside support angles, gussets, fastening bolts, embed anchors and an open elastomer trough. This is not a storm-drain grate or cable ramp. Road deck, pavement and vehicles are omitted; lower the assembly into its host surface until the finger plate top aligns with the road plane. No movement, drainage function, traffic load rating or road-standard compliance is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.400 × 0.371 × 1.288 m; 22,460 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
